title: BuildOcc: ATUS-grounded LLM occupant agents for building energy simulation
description:
Accompanying paper: Jung, W. (2026). BuildOcc: A large language model occupant agent platform for building energy research. SoftwareX, 103068. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.softx.2026.103068 (open access; accepted manuscript also at arXiv:2609.02729).

BuildOcc provides LLM-based occupant agents for building energy simulation, grounded in American Time Use Survey (ATUS) microdata. It offers a Python agent library, a REST API, and an MCP server, with ATUS-grounded activity scheduling across four demographic strata, persona generation with EIA RECS appliance priors, a Park et al. (2023) memory stream, a demand-response signal typology, and two-tier behavioral and energy validation metrics.
